purpose: Obtain truly previously undisclosed, independently measured protein-stability ΔΔG values and hold them until JANUS freezes real source-backed Boltz2 forecasts.
scope: New assay observations not present in FireProt/Tsuboyama/ProteinGym or other public/known label sets; count >=10 independent protein domains and >=200 point mutants only if 200 comparative predictions exist.
minimum_criteria: Measurements newly collected (or demonstrably held exclusively by independent lab prior to any JANUS model predictions).
JANUS cannot access actual labels, code books, raw outcome columns, or decrypted archive before frozen model-prediction receipt is immutable.
Custodian commits full ordered mutation+outcome collection digest and signs with key not held by JANUS.
Outside-party verifies signer identity, timestamp, source digests, and independent custody without relying on self-attested string fields.
No features, thresholds, assay units, sign transforms, or inclusion criteria may be tuned after outcome exposure.
New experimental source must be unrelated to S2 source and meet 10-domain/200-variant protocol size, subject to actual availability.
Experimental readout and sign must be independently attested using the original assay's definition.
Any preexisting label overlap or accidental disclosure triggers fail-closed and a newly preregistered trial.

cryptographic_commitment.normalized_canonical_serialization: UTF-8 JSON Lines sorted by (domain identifier, mutation identifier); each line contains stable specimen ID and original raw assay numerical result, unit, sign, replicate IDs, calibration and uncertainty.
cryptographic_commitment.commitment_algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical line-ending-preserved plaintext byte stream
cryptographic_commitment.encrypted_label_archive: Custodian-held, never stored in JANUS public GitHub, not represented by fabricated URL
cryptographic_commitment.signing: Detached signature from independently verified custodian's signing key; GitHub commit alone is not a cryptographic signature by a lab

external_review_context.source_sign_FireProtDB: Negative ddG stabilizing by FireProtDB convention; original assay-level sign audit required.
